findings.title: approve_change_order skips PENDING_APPROVAL gate; DRAFT CO inflates contract
findings.attacker: Insider or agent with create+approve access (or compromised skill caller)
findings.controls: submit_for_review / submit_for_approval enforce status; approve_change_order does not
findings.impact: Arbitrary DRAFT change order marked APPROVED; get_summary adds total_cost to current_contract

findings.title: approve_change_order from DRAFT with uncapped approved_amount → execute
findings.controls: execute_change_order checks APPROVED only; approve has no prior-status or amount vs proposed check
findings.impact: DRAFT→APPROVED→EXECUTED at attacker-chosen dollars; revised_contract inflated

findings.title: release_retention ignores check_release_conditions; releases with lien_waivers=False
findings.attacker: Anyone invoking release_retention (or automation that ignores check result)
findings.controls: check_release_conditions exists and returns ready_for_release=False; release_retention never calls it; lien_waivers flag is recorded only
findings.impact: Full retainage payout without lien waiver / surety / closeout docs

findings.title: Unverified RECEIVED waivers set waivers_complete and unlock can_release_payment
findings.attacker: Subcontractor (or anyone) uploading a file path via receive_waiver without verification
findings.controls: verify_waiver is a separate required step in the documented workflow but is not required by the release gate; reason string falsely says verified
findings.impact: Payment release authorized on unverified/unsigned waiver → lien exposure

findings.title: approve_pay_app from DRAFT with uncapped approved_amount; record_payment ungated
findings.controls: Workflow diagram requires Submit→Review→Approve; approve_pay_app checks only existence; approved_amount not capped to net_amount_due; record_payment does not require APPROVED
findings.impact: Overbill: DRAFT app approved/paid far above calculated net due

findings.title: record_payment marks PAID without APPROVED status or lien waiver
findings.controls: approve_payment and attach_lien_waiver exist; record_payment ignores both; get_missing_waivers is post-hoc only
findings.impact: Sub payment recorded complete without approval or waiver → compliance/lien exposure
